Korea has two number systems and you need both to buy coffee.

“Two iced americanos” = 아이스 아메리카노 두 잔 (native), but the price is 구천 원 (Sino-Korean).

Type any number and read it both ways 👇

Korea blooms south → north. Jeju ~Mar 22, Busan ~Mar 24, Jinhae festival ~Mar 25, Seoul ~Apr 2, peak Apr 7–14.

Book Seoul for the first two weeks of April and you’ll catch it.

Saving this for anyone planning spring 2027 ✨
